evidence: Conditional algebraic sizing and sufficient local planar geometry; no achieved lower-load attitude, complete spacecraft, validated material life, coupled flexible control, full-fleet coverage or collision certificate.
reading_rule: Representative candidates and model failures only. No universal optimum or architecture-wide infeasibility claim. Load-factor and service-pose choices do not demonstrate feasible commands. All old products remain unchanged.

assumptions.load_factors: scale all normal inertial/gravity coefficients of the inherited sampled command; solar pressure unchanged; lower factors are hypothetical load envelopes, not solved attitudes
assumptions.load_density: full trim hardware density applied everywhere for the normal-load envelope; actual trim area fraction used for mass
assumptions.geometry: scalloped support uses inherited dimension ratios; membrane sag stays at the inherited absolute tolerance
assumptions.envelope: finite outer tube/brace/cable envelope plus prescribed membrane sag and member deflection allowance; joint protrusions and global deformation remain unbounded
assumptions.coverage: sufficient inscribed rectangle projected at the scenario shingle angle; inherited pitch-to-active-rectangle ratios preserved; pitch factor below one increases overlap and population
assumptions.clearance: parallel along-pitch neighbour plane separation minus two finite normal half-envelopes; 150 m inherited gate unchanged; no sliding adjacent-ring, fault or fleet collision replay
assumptions.bus: fixed inherited avionics/housekeeping and hypothetical area-scaled equipment; power generation/storage/wiring, actuators, rotor supports and equipment-load closure omitted
assumptions.classification: member and geometric screens organize follow-up candidates; conservative failed screens cannot reject all supports or attitudes

mechanical.reading_rule: Every enumerated configuration is retained, including failures; ignored reproducible local run artifact.

configurations.reading_rule: Every enumerated configuration is retained, including failures; ignored reproducible local run artifact.

pareto_objectives: minimize normalized component or component-plus-assumed-bus mass
summary.pareto_rule: within common normal-load and bus scenarios, after member and parallel-clearance filters; dominance is conditional on this model and is never physical impossibility
